Name: JunimoCartMoreScore
Author: yaxuan97
Description:
Allow you get more score in JunimoCart minigame.
This Mod does not generate changes by default. You need to do the following steps to activate it.
1. Run the game once after installing the mod
2. Find and open the configuration file "config.json" in the mod folder
3. Modify the multiplier. The multiplier is an integer, because the game only supports integer scores
4. Enter the game and load your save(Remember to back up to avoid errors)

让你在祝尼莫赛车游戏中获得更多得分
这个Mod默认并不会产生更改。你需要做以下步骤激活它：
1. 安装Mod后运行一次游戏
2. 找到并打开Mod文件夹中的配置文件“config.json”
3. 修改倍率。倍率为整数，因为游戏只支持整数得分
4. 进入游戏并加载存档（记得提前备份以免出错）
